from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils.cell import range_boundaries

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/94-8/1_94-8_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/94-8_0_eb6e8569/1_94-8_output.xlsx")

sheet_name = "BeforeVBA"
answer_range = "A2:F9"

# Hard-coded Item = Sku whitelist. To adapt for 100+ entries, add one pair per line here.
pair_text = """
RPC0094 = 17343D
RPC0097 = 17263D
RPC0068 = 17232B
"""

def norm(v):
    return "" if v is None else str(v).strip().casefold()

valid_pairs = set()
for line in pair_text.strip().splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        item, sku = line.split("=", 1)
        valid_pairs.add((norm(item), norm(sku)))

# Load one workbook for writing and one data-only copy for reading computed values
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
wb_values = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)

ws = wb[sheet_name]
ws_values = wb_values[sheet_name]

min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

# Identify Item and Sku columns dynamically from the header row, with layout fallback.
headers = {}
for c in range(1, ws_values.max_column + 1):
    h = ws_values.cell(1, c).value
    if h is not None:
        headers[norm(h)] = c

item_col = headers.get("item", 4)
sku_col = headers.get("sku", 5)

# Read all actual data rows dynamically, not just the answer range.
kept_rows = []
for r in range(2, ws_values.max_row + 1):
    row_values = []
    row_has_data = False

    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        v = ws_values.cell(r, c).value
        raw_v = ws.cell(r, c).value
        if v is None and raw_v is not None and not (isinstance(raw_v, str) and raw_v.startswith("=")):
            v = raw_v
        row_values.append(v)
        if v is not None:
            row_has_data = True

    if not row_has_data:
        continue

    item_value = ws_values.cell(r, item_col).value
    sku_value = ws_values.cell(r, sku_col).value
    if item_value is None:
        raw_item = ws.cell(r, item_col).value
        if raw_item is not None and not (isinstance(raw_item, str) and raw_item.startswith("=")):
            item_value = raw_item
    if sku_value is None:
        raw_sku = ws.cell(r, sku_col).value
        if raw_sku is not None and not (isinstance(raw_sku, str) and raw_sku.startswith("=")):
            sku_value = raw_sku

    if (norm(item_value), norm(sku_value)) in valid_pairs:
        kept_rows.append(row_values)

# Modify only the answer cells: clear the range, then write filtered rows shifted upward.
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
        ws.cell(r, c).value = None

for i, row_values in enumerate(kept_rows[: max_row - min_row + 1], start=min_row):
    for offset, value in enumerate(row_values, start=min_col):
        ws.cell(i, offset).value = value

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification output
verify_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
verify_ws = verify_wb[sheet_name]
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    print([verify_ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1)])
